alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the supplied *The ... man*; the generic noun is supplied and the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 46 and 31).
Participial predicate rendered by the finite *considereth*.
The ASV writes a bare direct object, leaving the preposition's own relation unstated (rule 40).
Rectum takes the *of* and the supplied *the* (rules 19 and 46).
No interrogative or subordinating morpheme stands in this clause, so the supplied *How* answers to nothing (rules 30 and 55); the italic corroborates (rule 7).
Participle recast as a passive; the auxiliary belongs to the verb.
A possessive determiner written where the phrase's *the* would stand is what the ASV has written for the article (rule 41); no suffix or other morpheme in the clause licenses it.

review_notes: The margin's alternative rendering was read and set aside (rule 38).
*their* is italic in the ASV, but rule 41 gives a possessive standing in the article's place to the present article morpheme; the italic corroborates nothing here (rule 7).
